title: Sign in
caption: The sign-in page asks for a name and a password and nothing else.

title: RFI log with the record panel
caption: The RFI log lists every RFI the person may see, and the panel beside it shows the selected one with the actions it offers.

title: An RFI: Details
caption: The Details tab gives the question, the answer, the key facts and the timeline of one RFI.

title: An RFI: Properties
caption: The Properties tab lists the extra fields of the record and whether they meet the standard.

title: An RFI: History
caption: The History tab lists every change to the RFI, newest first, with who made it.

title: An RFI: Links
caption: The Links tab shows what the RFI points to and what points to it.

title: An RFI: Trace
caption: The Trace tab follows the links outward to show where the RFI leads.

title: An RFI: Thread
caption: The Thread tab reads the conversation on the RFI, oldest message first.

title: An RFI: Files
caption: The Files tab lists the attachments with their kind, size and page count.

title: Correspondence log
caption: The correspondence log lists letters and emails in and out, with the selected letter in the panel.

title: Document log with a page-1 image
caption: The document log shows the first page of a PDF revision beside its number, title and state.

title: PDF viewer
caption: The viewer opens a PDF in the page, with page controls, without leaving the web client.

title: A refused action
caption: An action that is not offered on a record is refused in plain words, and nothing changes.

title: A hidden record
caption: A record the person may not see answers exactly as one that does not exist.

title: RFI log on a phone
caption: At phone width the RFI log stacks the list and the panel in one column.

title: CWP register, 170 columns
caption: The CWP register lists the construction work packages with state, area and hours; the highlighted one is described beside the list.

title: CWP register, 100 columns
caption: At 100 columns the same register moves the panel below the list.

title: WBS tree
caption: The work breakdown structure is a tree of nodes with the cost codes mapped to each leaf.

title: CWA register
caption: The construction work areas appear in the order of the path of construction, with their CWPs.

title: A CWP record
caption: Enter on a CWP opens its record: allocation to the WBS, packages, activity links and timeline.

title: tl awp cwp ls
caption: The CWPs of the project, one line each: number, state, discipline, area, hours and title.

title: tl awp wbs tree
caption: The WBS printed depth first, each level indented, with the cost codes of the leaves.

title: tl awp report
caption: The three awp reports: CWP status by state, WBS against cost code, and the area sequence.

title: tl awp path, cwa and package
caption: The path of construction with its versions, the work areas, and the engineering and procurement packages.

title: tl load targets
caption: The load targets the legacy loader knows, now including the awp and materials ones.
